integrity: The equality classification is obtained by exhaustive prefix-closed enumeration with an exact suffix criterion, followed by a separate whole-factor recheck of all six boundary words and an exact symmetry-orbit computation.
scientific_limitations: The maximum length 9 and the avoidability-index consequence are prior work. The new claim is the complete six-word equality set and its two reversal/complement symmetry orbits. An unpublished computation or unindexed auxiliary file could contain the same equality list.
title: Complete extremizer classification for the binary undirected-cube obstruction
